name: ImageResize
syntax: ImageResize( any image, string width, [string height], [string interpolation], [number blurFactor] )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: width
params.description: New width of the image. If this value is blank, the width is calculated proportionately to the height.

params.name: height
params.description: New height of the image. If this value is blank, the height is calculated proportionately to the width.

params.name: interpolation
params.description:
the interpolation method for resampling. You can specify a specific interpolation algorithm by name (for example, hamming), by image quality (for example, mediumQuality), or by performance (for example, highestPerformance). Valid values are:

- highestQuality (default)
- highQuality
- mediumQuality
- highestPerformance
- highPerformance
- mediumPerformance
- nearest
- bilinear
- bicubic
- bessel
- blackman
- hamming
- hanning
- hermite
- lanczos
- mitchell
- quadratic

params.name: blurFactor
params.description: The blur factor used for resampling. The higher the blur factor, the more blurred the image (also, the longer it takes to resize the image). Valid values are 0-10.
